info.name: LMS Security Fixes - Complete Testing
info.description:
Complete security testing for P0/P1/P2 fixes.

## Prerequisites
1. `firebase emulators:start`
2. `cd backend && npm run start:dev`
3. `cd backend && node scripts/setup-postman-users.js` ← Creates Firebase Auth users with roles
4. `cd backend && node scripts/seed-category.js` ← Creates test category in PostgreSQL

## Test Users
| User | Email | Password | Role |
|------|-------|----------|------|
| Instructor | instructor@test.com | password123 | instructor |
| Student1 (enrolled) | student1@test.com | password123 | student |
| Student2 (not enrolled) | student2@test.com | password123 | student |
| Admin | admin@test.com | password123 | admin |

## What Gets Created (by 00-Global-Setup)
- 1 test course (DRAFT → PUBLISHED)
- 1 section with 2 lectures (1 free preview, 1 paid)
- Student1 enrolled, Student2 NOT enrolled

## Important
- Run 00-Global-Setup folder FIRST (in order) before any test folder
- Each test folder can then be run independently
- POST /me/sync provisions user rows in PostgreSQL (required after each login)

## Security Tests
- **P0**: Progress/Completion Forgery, Enrollment Verification, Server-Side Completion
- **P1**: Refresh Token Revocation on Role Change
- **P2**: Upload & Streaming Hardening (code review only - requires Firebase Storage)

item.description: Completion is derived server-side from watched duration / total duration. 90% threshold. Client 'completed' flag is ignored.

item.name: P1-Revoke-Refresh-Tokens
item.description:
After admin changes a user's role, stale refresh tokens should be revoked so old sessions cannot continue.

⚠️ NOTE: Firebase Auth Emulator does NOT support token revocation. This test demonstrates the API flow but the old refresh token will still work in the emulator. In production Firebase, tokens ARE properly revoked.

item.name: P1-2: Admin Changes Student1 Role → instructor

request.description: Admin changes Student1 role. This should trigger refresh token revocation in production.

item.name: P1-3: Old Refresh Token Should Fail (Emulator Limitation)

console.log('⚠️  NOTE: Old refresh token still works (emulator limitation)');
console.log('   Production Firebase DOES revoke tokens on role change.');
pm.test.skip('Old refresh token rejected (skipped - emulator limitation)', function() {});

request.description:
